description:
Correction, 2026-09-25. This version contains 58 records from four songs (Chopin Op. 9 No. 2 and Op. 28 No. 4, Beethoven Op. 13 II, Schumann Op. 15 No. 7) whose source files came from midiworld.com and bitmidi.com, not from piano-midi.de, and carry no established arrangement licence. The attribution to Bernd Krueger under CC-BY-SA-3.0-DE given below is correct only for the other four works. Access to the files of this version is restricted; please do not redistribute copies of these records. The corrected release is version 0.6.0 (10.5281/zenodo.22961580), which keeps the 57 cleared records unchanged. Details: the licence audit.

jam-actions-v0 is a corpus of multi-turn MCP (Model Context Protocol) tool-use traces grounded in real classical-piano MIDI. Each record pairs a short phrase window (typically 4 measures) with an annotated teaching target and a target trace — a turn-by-turn session in which an assistant uses the ai-jam-sessions MCP tools to read, analyze, and discuss the phrase. The dataset teaches LLMs to do grounded tool-use over symbolic music, not just text generation.

This is the public subset: 115 records across 8 compositions (Bach, Mozart, Beethoven, Chopin, Schumann, Debussy). The held-out test set is clair-de-lune (12 records); the train split is 103 records. All records have verified provenance against piano-midi.de.

The package includes 270 files: per-record JSON, the consolidated records.jsonl, SVG piano-rolls, eval artifacts (n=3 multi-run baselines, per-stratum aggregates, release-gate assessments), curated docs (README dataset card, layered LICENSE, ATTRIBUTION with copy-pasteable strings, KNOWN_LIMITATIONS for honest scope, DATASET_SCHEMA, RELEASE_NOTES, CITATION.cff), a SHA-256 checksums file, and packaging metadata. A fresh contributor can clone the source repo, verify all 270 checksums in ~2 seconds, and reproduce the canonical Slice 22 RC-gate PASS verdict end-to-end without operator handholding.

Licensing: three-layer stack. Compositions are public domain (US + EU). MIDI arrangements by Bernd Krueger / piano-midi.de under CC-BY-SA 3.0 (Germany jurisdiction). Derivative records under CC-BY-SA-3.0 (DE) via share-alike. Zenodo's enumerated license slug is CC-BY-SA-3.0 (international form) — the substantive obligations are identical; the DE jurisdiction is documented in ATTRIBUTION.md and LICENSE-DATASET.md.

Reproducibility: clone, pnpm install, run verify-public-package-checksums.ts, run check-release-gate.ts against evals/slice21-fair-e3-baseline-results.json. Expected: 270/270 checksums verify; release-gate exits 0 with PASS on all 6 blocking axes.
notes: Superseded on 2026-09-25 by version 0.6.0 (10.5281/zenodo.22961580), a correction release. This version contains 58 records whose source arrangements have no established licence; its files are restricted. Earlier notes: This dataset is a candidate release. A PASS verdict on the RC gate (release-gate-assessment/2.0.0) does NOT mean the dataset is approved for release; per the source-repo doctrine 'gate clearance is not release approval.' The Slice 22 PASS artifact at evals/slice22-release-gate-revised-assessment.json is the canonical reference for the current state. See KNOWN_LIMITATIONS.md for honest scope (8 songs, single-arranger, piano-only, English-only annotations). See RELEASE_NOTES.md for the full version arc 0.1.0 → 0.4.3.
access_conditions: Files restricted on 2026-09-25: this version contains records built from MIDI arrangements whose licence could not be established. The corrected release is version 0.6.0, https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.22961580, which is open.
